post.caption:
Consonance is arithmetic. An octave is a 2:1 frequency ratio, a fifth is 3:2, and the simpler the ratio the more the waves line up. The problem is that stacking perfect fifths never lands you back on the starting note, so the circle does not close. Equal temperament shares that error out evenly, detuning every interval slightly so that every key is playable. Which means a piano is deliberately, subtly wrong everywhere.
